newsitem.title: USA: Vion says gets patent for HIV treatment.
newsitem.headline: Vion says gets patent for HIV treatment.

text.p: Vion Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday that the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office issued a patent covering the method of use of B-L-Fd4C, the company's novel L-2', 3'-didehydro-dideoxy-5-fluorocytidine nucleoside analog, against HIV.
The company said this patent complements an earlier one issued relating to the composition of matter and method of use against the Hepatitis B Virus.
The company said it now has exclusive worldwide rights to the two patents covering the composition and use of B-L-Fd4C for HBV and HIV.
